title: F126.3.2 the run pages: the overview
caption: Five parts: an area a site opts into, a client that reads the eval routes, the list of evals, a run with its conversations failed first, and a conversation turn by turn. Nothing here starts a run: that is F126.3.4's.

cards.title: F126.3.2 The run pages
cards.code: a run is read in the admin
cards.text: Three pages in a site's admin read the runs the API keeps: the evals, a run, and a conversation.

cards.title: An opt-in area
cards.text: One word among a site's areas brings the pages, the sidebar's link and the home's card.

cards.title: The client
cards.text: The list, a run and an eval's runs, read with the options the run was written with.

cards.title: The evals
cards.text: One card per eval file: its agent, its conversations, and how its last run went.

cards.title: A run
cards.text: The number first, then the conversations, failed first, each saying why.

cards.title: A conversation
cards.text: One repeat at a time: each turn's ask, tool calls, answer and marks.
